column2: Sure, sometimes it's hard.{wait}{clear}But saying so and not doing it won't get me anywhere, right? If I die, it's all for nothing.
Just when I finally feel like doing it, you come and bother me with that?{wait}{clear}Either watch quietly or go home, would you?
Dedicated...? Is that how it looks...? Well, fine. Let's just say that's what it is.
Who knows. You could say I am, you could say I'm not. Well, I've got enough to fight.{wait}{clear}You sure worry about weird things.
Getting hurt? Sure, I'm training, but one look at me and you can see there's no need to worry, right?
Not much, but I do mind people watching, so I don't do this anywhere I'd get interrupted.{wait}{clear}So don't interrupt me either, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
No, same as always. Is something bothering you?
I guess. Without that, there's nothing to keep you going.{wait}{clear}But it doesn't matter that much to me, personally.
If you think so, you could just not come... but you'd still worry, right?{wait}{clear}You really don't have to worry about it.
Yeah, so many it's a pain. Well, you might not understand how someone like me thinks.
Well, I suppose so. Right now there's so much out of the ordinary that doing my usual stuff is the change of pace.
Abrupt as ever.{wait}{clear}But I'd rather not remember much about when I was little... Sorry...
Sure, if that's what you want, go ahead. I don't mind.{wait}{clear}It's nice to relax like this once in a while, right?
Haha... You're stricter than you look.{wait}{clear}Well, I guess you couldn't guard the world otherwise...
Yeah, I'll take you up on that. Why don't you relax a little too, ＄＄＄＄＄＄?
Sometimes... But thinking things through isn't my strong suit.
Of course I go. Rather than moping in a place like this, going out for a drink takes my mind off things.
Yeah... You don't need to worry about that. I'm not a kid.
I know...
Spare me the empty comfort. We've come this far, so calm down, will you?
Yeah... I know...
Hahaha... Harsh... But naturally. I have no intention of letting my guard down.
Don't you think there's no point worrying now? We'll find out when we fight. Whatever happens, happens.
If you're that worried, you didn't have to come all this way...{wait}{clear}Do you trust me that little? Me?
I'm sure you'll be fine, Rocus.
Yeah... I hope so... Though even if you say that, I don't plan to let my guard down.
Don't say ominous stuff like that. What a pain you are...
...Geez, what good is it if YOU can't calm down? If you make that face, it makes me uneasy, right?
No... It's not your fault, ＄＄＄＄＄＄... I just wasn't strong enough.
Don't make such a fuss. I didn't want you to see me looking this pathetic...
Thanks don't mean anything if I couldn't beat the enemy, right?{wait}{clear}And getting wounded like this... It's the worst...
No, there's no point counting on you anyway... Don't worry about it too much.
No... Anyway, don't worry so much. Just being seen like this is humiliating...{wait}{clear}It's just... Ah, no, never mind...
An apology from you only makes it awkward. Besides, this is because I wasn't strong enough, not your fault.
No... I don't mind being relied on... It's just pathetic that I couldn't live up to it...
Say no more... I don't want to hear your excuses.
Harsh, at a time like this... But you may be right...
Yeah...{wait}{clear}Sorry, but I'll do that.
The Church
Rocus, you're going to become Pope, aren't you?
